{{Top}} {{Otheruses|Tristan}} {{MultipleIssues|image|expand|updatecontent=[[Star Wars: Timelines]]}} {{Character |type=Mandalorian |image=[[File:Tristan_Wren_HeroesofMandalore.png]] |option1=Face |image2=[[File:TristanWren-HoM1.png]] |option2=Helmet |image3=[[File:TristanWrenImpArmor-LoM.png]] |option3=Imperial |name=Tristan Wren |homeworld=[[Krownest]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' |birth=After [[21 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' states that [[Sabine Wren]] was born in [[21 BBY]]. Since "[[Art History]]" establishes that Tristan is the younger of the siblings, he must be born after 21 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. |death=Between [[4 ABY]] and [[5 ABY]], [[Mandalore]]{{Ahsoka|Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord}} states that the [[Great Purge of Mandalore]] took place near the end of the [[Galactic Civil War]] which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates as ending in [[5 ABY]]. It can be deduced that the Great Purge occurred between [[4 ABY]] and 5 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]]. Therefore, Tristan Wren must have passed away between 4 ABY and 5 ABY. |species=[[Human]]{{Rebels|Trials of the Darksaber}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=He/him{{Databank|tristan-wren|Tristan Wren}} |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]]{{Rebels|Legacy of Mandalore}} |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Tan |cyber= |families=*[[House Vizsla]] **[[Clan Wren]] |parents=*[[Alrich Wren]]{{Rebels|Heroes of Mandalore}} *[[Ursa Wren]] |partners= |siblings=[[Sabine Wren]] |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Imperial Super Commando]]s *[[Mandalorian resistance]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|I choose family.|Tristan, to Viceroy Gar Saxon|}} '''Tristan Wren''', the brother of [[Sabine Wren]], was a [[Mandalorian]] [[human]] [[Gender|male]]. He was the son of [[Alrich Wren|Alrich]] and [[Ursa Wren]], who led [[Clan Wren]]. After Sabine deserted the [[Imperial Academy of Mandalore|Imperial Academy]] on [[Mandalore]], Tristan was forced to join [[Gar Saxon]]'s [[Imperial Super Commando|Super Commandos]] in order to keep their clan's dignity. In [[2 BBY]], Tristan reunited with his sister Sabine after she and her rebel companions tried to convince Clan Wren to aid the rebellion. When Gar Saxon ordered the destruction of Clan Wren, Tristan chose his family and joined the rebels and [[Fenn Rau]] in defeating Saxon and his warriors. Tristan later helped Sabine and her rebel allies to evacuate the [[Phoenix Cell]] during the [[Battle of Atollon]]. He and his family fought against [[Clan Saxon]] and the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Mandalorian Civil War (Imperial Era)|Mandalorian Civil War]]. By the end of the [[Galactic Civil War]], Tristan, along with his parents, was killed during the [[Night of a Thousand Tears]], leaving his sister as the only survivor and member of Clan Wren. ==Biography== ===Early life=== Tristan Wren was the son of [[Alrich Wren]], [[Countess]] [[Ursa Wren]] and the younger brother of [[Sabine Wren]], [[Reproduction|born]] at some point after Sabine's birth in [[21 BBY]]. After Sabine abandoned the [[Imperial Academy of Mandalore|Imperial Academy]] on [[Mandalore]] and joined the rebellion, [[Clan Wren]]'s loyalties to the Empire were called into question. Tristan was forced to join [[Viceroy]] [[Gar Saxon]]'s [[Imperial Super Commando]]s in order to prove his family's loyalty to Saxon and the [[Galactic Empire]]. His father was also kept a hostage of Saxon on Mandalore to guarantee his family's loyalty. Tristan lived with his mother Ursa Wren on the planet [[Krownest]], their family's [[homeworld]]. ===Reunion with Sabine=== [[File:Tristan_ImperialSuperCommando_LegacyOfMandalore.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Tristan confronts the Spectres]] In [[2 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Legacy of Mandalore]]" to [[2 BBY]]. Tristan led a patrol of Clan Wren warriors which intercepted and shot down Sabine's [[shuttle]] ''[[Phantom II]]''. Sabine and her rebel comrades [[Kanan Jarrus]], [[Ezra Bridger]], [[Fenn Rau]], and [[C1-10P|Chopper]] were traveling on a mission to Krownest to solicit Clan Wren's support for the rebellion. After the ''Phantom II'' crashed on the snow, Tristan and his comrades confronted Sabine, Kanan, and Ezra. Tristan initially did not recognize Sabine because she was wearing her Mandalorian helmet. When Ezra ignited his [[Sabine Wren's lightsaber|green lightsaber]], Tristan and his companions opened fire, leading to a brief firefight. When he heard Sabine's voice, Tristan ordered a cease fire and removed his helmet. While Tristan was friendly towards Sabine and her rebel friends and agreed to lead them to the [[Wren Stronghold]], he warned Sabine that he could not vouch for their mother's hospitality. During the journey, Sabine confronted Tristan about his Imperial Super Commando armor. Tristan warned that she should not have returned since her family still regarded her as a traitor. Upon arriving at the Wren Stronghold, Ursa ordered Sabine's incarceration but Sabine managed to convince her mother to grant her and her friends an audience by showing the [[Darksaber]], an important symbol of [[House Vizsla]]; of which Clan Wren was a member. Ursa reluctantly acceded to her daughter's request but ordered the rebels to surrender their weapons. [[File:Tristan_Sabine_sparring_LegacyOfMandalore.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Tristan and Sabine sparring]] Inside the throne room, Tristan and his warriors maintained a vigil as Ursa appraised her daughter of their family's circumstances. Tristan and his mother regarded the [[Journeyman Protector|Mandalorian Protectors]] and their leader Fenn Rau as traitors and sought to justify the Protectors' execution by Saxon. After Ursa and Sabine left for a private meeting, the [[Jedi]] Rebels Ezra tried to make light conversation with Tristan. However, Kanan insisted on handling the negotiations and told Tristan that he desired an audience with Countess Ursa. Tristan later informed his mother and sister that Gar Saxon was requesting a [[hologram]] conversation with Ursa. Still on good terms with Sabine, Tristan invited her for a sparring session in the training room. While sparring with metal rods, Sabine thanked Tristan for practicing with her. When Sabine asked if he thought she was a [[Treason|traitor]], Tristan told her he did not think so but that the other clans viewed them with suspicion. Tristan vowed to help restore his family's standing to protect their father. Tristan then informed his sister of their mother's plan to trade the rebels and the Darksaber with Saxon in return for their safety. Tristan followed Sabine to the throne room where they discovered Gar Saxon and his Super Commandos taking the Jedi rebels and the Darksaber into their custody. When Sabine protested, Tristan told her that it was for the best. When Ursa demanded that Saxon uphold his side of the bargain, Saxon ordered his men to [[Skirmish on Krownest|exterminate]] Clan Wren for "colluding" with rebels. Tristan protested but Saxon gave him the choice of standing by him or dying with his family. Tristan chose his family and pointed his blaster at Saxon. The Wrens and rebels were aided by Rau, who handed the Jedi their weapons and helped the rebels and Clan Wren defeat Saxon's warriors. Tristan shot the last of Saxon's Super Commandos. Tristan and and the others then watched as Sabine dueled with Saxon on the ice outside their stronghold, using Ezra's lightsaber. Sabine managed to defeat Saxon and reclaimed the Darksaber. However, she spared Saxon's life. When Saxon tried to kill her, Ursa shot him dead. Sabine's defeat of Saxon regained her family's respect. Sabine and Fenn elected to stay behind with Tristan and his mother to help them reunify the Mandalorian people in the wake of Saxon's death. Tristan and his family watched as Ezra and Kanan departed aboard the ''Phantom II'' to rejoin the rebellion. Tristan and the others listened as Sabine vowed to help them find Mandalore's true leader. ===Civil War=== ====Assault on Tarre Vizsla's statue==== [[File:Tristan_Sabine_Statue_ArtHistory.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Tristan and Sabine admire the freed Tarre Vizsla statue]] Following the death of Gar Saxon, Clan Wren was involved in a [[Mandalorian Civil War (Imperial Era)|civil war]] against the Imperial-backed [[Clan Saxon]]. Clan Wren's forces were stretched thin defending their holdings.{{Rebels|Zero Hour}} While combating Imperial forces on Mandalore, Tristan accompanied his sister on a mission through rocky cliffs, approaching a large and ancient [[statue of Tarre Vizsla]]. Tristan asked her how she knew the place so well, and Sabine explained that their father brought her to see the statue when she was a child and he was still an infant. As they approached the statue, both used their helmets' [[macrobinocular viewplate]]s and [[rangefinder]]s to see the Imperial [[stormtrooper]]s and the outpost built around it.{{FOD|Art History}} Although Tristan was hesitant and unwilling to risk getting caught and jeopardize their mission for the sake of a statue, Sabine insisted the statue was too important to Mandalore's history to leave in Imperial hands. Tristan sighed and remarked that he liked her better when she was off in [[Realspace|space]], but followed Sabine. The two climbed the statue and while he planted [[detonator]]s across the outpost's structure, Sabine wielded the Darksaber to slice its metal support beams. After successfully avoiding the stormtroopers' sight, they retreated to a safe distance and Tristan activated the detonators and destroyed the outpost. [[Tarre Vizsla]]'s statue freed, they climbed up to its face and Tristan remarked the statue looked happy, admitting they did the right thing, "for Mandalore." ====Battle of Atollon==== [[File:Sabine_Ezra_Tristan_BattleOfAtollon_ZeroHour.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Tristan Wren fought in the Battle of Atollon.]] When Ezra Bridger and the rebel [[astromech droid]] Chopper returned with news of [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] [[Battle of Atollon|siege]] of [[Chopper Base]], Tristan was sympathetic to the rebels but shared his mother Ursa Wren's view that Clan Wren could not assist the rebels. Following some discussion, Ursa relented and allowed Ezra and Sabine to depart with several volunteers and ships. Tristan accompanied Sabine's strike team and took part in a successful assault on an [[Interdictor-class heavy cruiser|''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser]]. The interdictor cruiser's destruction enabled the surviving [[Phoenix Cell]] forces to retreat to [[Yavin 4]]. This action solidified the alliance between Clan Wren and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]]. ====Mission to Mandalore==== Tristan accompanied his family, Fenn Rau, Clan Wren's forces, and several Spectres members on a [[Mission to Mandalore|campaign]] against [[Governor]] [[Tiber Saxon]] and the Empire on Mandalore. Tristan remained with his mother Ursa while Sabine led a strike team to rescue their father Alrich from an [[Mandalore prison outpost|Imperial prison]]. Ursa subsequently received intelligence that the Empire had already moved Alrich and had set a trap at the prison. After Lady [[Bo-Katan Kryze]]'s forces helped Sabine's forces to defeat the Imperial garrison, Tristan arrived with his mother, who informed Sabine that Alrich was being transported by an Imperial convoy to the capital [[Sundari]] for execution. While Sabine and her allies freed Alrich, Tristan and his mother commanded a successful skirmish against Governor Saxon's Imperial Super Commandos. With the battle going in Clan Wren's favor, Tristan and Ursa were contacted by Sabine, who informed them of their victory. While Ursa was reporting on their victory, Tristan spotted the arrival of a single Imperial reinforcement: a modified [[All Terrain Defense Pod]]. This walker was equipped with an [[Arc Pulse Generator]] known as the "Duchess," which was capable of incinerating Mandalorian warriors. The "Duchess" reacted against the [[beskar]] alloy inside the armor, incinerating the warriors and leaving behind charred armor. [[File:Alrich_Ursa_Tristan_HeroesOfMandalore.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Tristan with his parents on Mandalore]] Due to Sabine's warning, Tristan and Ursa managed to take shelter and survived the massacre. The two were later rescued by Sabine's forces, who evacuated aboard one of Lady Bo-Katan's ships. During the journey, Tristan and the others learned about Sabine's role in creating the weapon during her Imperial Academy days. After arriving at Lady Bo-Katan's base, Sabine offered to lead an assault to destroy the "Duchess" and the associated data in order to make amends for her wrongs. The weapon and the data was stored aboard Governor Saxon's [[Tiber Saxon's Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]], which was docking above Sundari. Tristan volunteered to join his sister's strike team. During the assault, Tristan and Fenn Rau fought Imperial forces in the [[hangar]] bay of Saxon's Star Destroyer while Sabine and Bo-Katan destroyed the weapon, causing an explosion which engulfed the Star Destroyer. Meanwhile, the Spectres Ezra, Chopper, and Kanan deleted the data. Tristan and his rebel and Mandalorian comrades escaped the Star Destroyer before it crashed to the ground. Following the destruction of the "Duchess," Tristan and his family joined the other Mandalorian clans in pledging [[Mandalorian resistance|allegiance]] to Lady Bo-Katan, who inherited the Darksaber and the mantle of Mandalorian leadership. ===Death in the Night of a Thousand Tears=== {{Quote|I know you feel that Ezra Bridger is the only family you have left.''"
"''You don't know what you're talking about.''"
"''I know that's what's holding you back. Your family died on Mandalore because your Master didn't trust you.|Baylan Skoll, to Sabine Wren|{{Ahsoka|Part Four: Fallen Jedi}}}} [[File:Massacre-on-Mandalore.png|thumb|right|250x250px|Tristan Wren and his family died during the Night of a Thousand tears]]Towards the end of the [[Galactic Civil War]], the Empire massacred the Mandalorian people in the [[Great Purge of Mandalore]]. [[Moff]] [[Gideon]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau|ISB]] would lead the [[Night of a Thousand Tears]], ultimately leading to the death of Tristan and his family along with the rest of Clan Wren. Sabine, who had been on Lothal since Thrawn's defeat five years prior, had survived and had been training to be a Jedi under the apprenticeship of [[Ahsoka Tano]].{{Ahsoka|Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord}} ===Legacy=== {{Quote|At the end of the war, the Empire purged the entire surface of the planet, killing hundreds of thousands.''"''
''"''Her family?''"''
''"''Were all lost, sadly.|Huyang and Ezra Bridger on Sabine's family|}} With the loss of her family Tano ended the training, fearing that Sabine's emotions over the loss of her family were the only driving force of her training. Baylan Skoll would recount the deaths of Tristan and his parents during his confrontation with Sabine Wren on [[Seatos]]{{Ahsoka|Part Four: Fallen Jedi}} in [[9 ABY]],{{AhsokaSeriesDate}} where the fallen [[Jedi Knight]] observed that with the loss of her clan, Wren considered the missing Ezra Bridger the only "family" she had left. In turn, it allowed Skoll to persuade Wren to surrender in order to find Bridger. The Purge and the loss of Clan Wren was recounted to Ezra Bridger on the [[extragalactic]] planet of [[Peridea]] by [[architect droid]] professor [[Huyang]].{{Ahsoka|Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord}} ==Personality and traits== [[File:TristanWren-CGSWG.png|thumb|200px|left|Tristan Wren was a capable warrior, both pragmatic and loyal.]] Tristan Wren was a [[Gender|male]] [[Mandalorian]] youth with black hair and brown eyes. He was a capable but conflicted warrior. While Tristan loved his family, he grappled with his sister Sabine's decision to abandon the Imperial Academy and join the rebellion. Tristan was loyal to Clan Wren and sought to protect his family's interests by serving as an Imperial Super Commando. Despite his Imperial alignment, Tristan remained on good terms with his sister and treated her with respect and love. When Gar Saxon ordered his family's execution, Tristan chose his family and helped them and their rebel allies defeat Saxon and his Commandos. As a pragmatist, Tristan was sympathetic to the rebels but opined that Clan Wren lacked the resources to render assistance to the rebels at Atollon. He later reconsidered and took part in a successful operation to disable one of Thrawn's Interdictor cruisers, allowing the Phoenix Squadron to escape. Tristan later helped his mother Ursa to command Clan Wren's forces during the civil war against Clan Saxon and the Empire. He was loyal to his family and helped Sabine to destroy the "Duchess," an Imperial energy weapon capable of reacting with Mandalorian armor. ==Skills and abilities== {{Quote|You've been practicing, brother.|Sabine Wren acknowledging Tristan's sparring skills|}} [[File:Tristan_jetpack_HeroesOfMandalore.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Tristan operating a jetpack]] Tristan Wren was a Mandalorian warrior whose skills included marksmanship, melee combat, and the use of [[Mandalorian armor]] and [[Mandalorian vambrace|vambraces]]. He possessed remarkable warrior abilities, much like his sister,{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files|cardname=REB-30 - Tristan Wren}} and matched well against her in a fight. Tristan was capable at using weapons including a [[blaster rifle]], [[blaster pistol]], and a [[staff]] and also knew how to operate a [[jetpack]]. ==Equipment== As an Imperial Super Commando, Tristan Wren wore white Mandalorian armor with yellow and red accents on the shoulders and a white [[helmet]] and jetpack. He also used a blaster rifle for combat. After leaving the Super Commandos, Wren wore a suit of Mandalorian armor made out of beskar with the gray and yellow coloring typical of Clan Wren warriors with a pair of matching vambraces and a helmet equipped with a macrobinocular viewplate and rangefinder. He also carried a a pair of [[WESTAR-35 blaster pistol]]s. On the right shoulder, Wren's armor was marked with an illustration of a [[loth-cat]] by his sister Sabine Wren.{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/zero-hour-trivia-gallery|text="Zero Hour" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|slide 8}} ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|The idea of Sabine having a sibling has been a story thread evolving over the course of the series. In series preproduction, Sabine was to have a twin sister name Sacha. Later, it was changed to a brother, and at one point, the character was to be the Protector of Concord Dawn.|"Legacy of Mandalore" episode guide|{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/legacy-of-mandalore-trivia-gallery|text="Legacy of Mandalore" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|slide 4}}}} Tristan Wren made his first appearance in "[[Legacy of Mandalore]]," an episode of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|third season]] of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. He was voiced by [[Ritesh Rajan]]. In the early development of the episode, his name was Jona Wren. Sabine having a sibling was an idea the ''Rebels'' producers had since during initial development of the show, but they originally intended for her to have a twin sister called Sacha. They eventually changed her sibling's gender and considered introducing him earlier as a Mandalorian Protector, but he was replaced by the new character named Fenn Rau. ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|Trials of the Darksaber}} {{1stm}} *{{Rebels|Legacy of Mandalore}} {{1st}} {{1stID|Tristan Wren}} *{{FOD|Art History}} *{{Rebels|Zero Hour}} *{{Rebels|Heroes of Mandalore}} *{{Ahsoka|Part Four: Fallen Jedi}} {{Imo}} *{{Ahsoka|Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== *{{HelmetCollectionCite|63|Highlights of the Saga}} *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/legacy-of-mandalore-episode-guide|text="Legacy of Mandalore" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/zero-hour-episode-guide|text="Zero Hour" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|74|Databank A-Z}} *''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' *{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/heroes-of-mandalore-episode-guide|text="Heroes of Mandalore" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}} *{{InsiderCite|180|Rebel Journey}} *{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files|cardname=REB-30 - Tristan Wren}} *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' *{{GermanFanCite|104|Database}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|sabine-wren|Sabine Wren}} *{{Databank|tristan-wren|Tristan Wren}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Tristan Wren}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Tristan Wren |fr=Tristan Wren |ja=トリスタン・レン |ka=ტრისტან რენი |nl=Tristan Wren |pl=Tristan Wren |uk=Трістан Врен }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Wren, Tristan}} [[Category:Clan Wren]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial defectors]] [[Category:Imperial Super Commandos]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Mandalorian resistance members]]
